name: NodeRegistration
description: Register a node with a locked stake; the owner proves control of the node key.

params.name: sender_privkey
params.help: the signing key: 32-byte Ed25519 seed as 64 hex; '-' or omitted = ZBC_KEY

params.name: node_privkey
params.help: the node's private key; its public key goes in the body

body.name: proof_of_ownership
body.computed: 136 bytes: owner address (36) ‖ latest block hash (32) ‖ latest block height u32le ‖ Ed25519(owner seed, those 72 bytes); block from GET /api/v1/blocks/latest

notes: zbc-node-register takes (node_privkey, owner_privkey, locked_balance): node key first, then the owner key that signs.
